author: Nintendo of America
description:
Super Meat Boy 3D launches today on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/super-meat-boy-3d-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01  

Super Meat Boy is a brutal platformer that sees you guide a cube of meat on a mission to rescue his bandage-made girlfriend from an evil fetus in a tuxedo jar—now in 3D! Wall-jump past buzz saws, crumbling caves, and flaming forests, all while dying a million times along the way. With old-school difficulty, twitchy reflexes, epic bosses, and loads of secrets, it’s Meat Boy like never before! 

#NintendoSwitch2 #SuperMeatBoy3D

description:
Play Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Gold Edition now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/tmnt-splintered-fate-gold-edition-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01

Intense ninja turtle action is back! Choose your favorite Turtle or one of the Casey Jones, Metalhead, or Alopex Character DLCs included in the Gold Edition. Grab your friends and jump into an roguelike adventure to save Master Splinter from the Foot Clan! After, play through the additional adventure of Casey Jones and the Junkyard Jam, available in both Campaign and Arcade modes.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Tetris® 99 52nd MAXIMUS CUP event runs from 12 a.m. PT on April 3 to 11:59 p.m. PT on April 6. To participate, you’ll need to be a Nintendo Switch Online member* and play the Tetris 99 online mode during the event period. You’ll earn event points based on your placement in each match. Once you’ve accumulated a total of 100 event points, a new theme will unlock, featuring art, music and Tetrimino designs inspired by the Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2 game!

*Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. This game includes an in-game purchase option for users who do not have a membership. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available in all countries. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply. nintendo.com/purchase-terms/
